text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Why are there monsters on the beach...?! We have to protect everyone...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうして魔物がビーチに……！
みんなを守らないと……！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: We have to do our best until the people who can't fight evacuate!
text_block_list.orig_text:
戦えない人たちが避難するまで、
あたしたちが頑張らないとだね！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Even though they were captured to spice up the tournament, we can't let them rampage here. Let's make them leave quickly.
text_block_list.orig_text:
大会を盛り上げるために囚われていたとはいえ、
今ここで暴れられては困る。
早々に立ち去ってもらおう。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: That's right! We were having a hard time competing with each other...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだよー！　
せっかくあたしたち、
一生懸命に競い合えてたのに……

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Hiyori... I see. So you've learned the joy of competing with your friends in this sea, huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヒヨリ……
そうか。
この海で、
仲間と競い合うことの楽しさを覚えたんだね。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Well then... Once this is over, let's have another match at the game. Of course, after we recover our stamina.
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ……これが終わったら
またゲームで対決しようか。
もちろんちゃんと体力を回復してからね。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Agreed! All right, let's do this with all our might.
text_block_list.orig_text:
賛成賛成ー！　
よーっし！
はりきって行っくよー！
